quotes.text: A boy without a name still has a story.
Some memories are not remembered. They are felt.
Home is not a place — it's the people who wait for you.
The first step is always the hardest — and the most important.
quotes.source: Chapter Four — First Steps into School

quotes.text: Sometimes a family breaks, but love never truly leaves.
Life jumps when you're not ready — that's how you grow.
Respect is earned in silence, not announced in noise.
Rank is a number. The will to rise has no ceiling.
quotes.source: Chapter Eight — The Will to Rise

quotes.text: Dreams don't shout — they quietly take shape.
quotes.source: Chapter Nine — A Dream Takes Shape

quotes.text: Some farewells teach us how to say hello to a new self.
quotes.source: Chapter Ten — A Tribute and a Farewell

quotes.text: The child is father of the man.
There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you.
Death is not the greatest loss in life. The greatest loss is what dies inside us while we live.
Home is where one starts from.
It always seems impossible until it is done.
We do not remember days, we remember moments.
Every new beginning comes from some other beginning's end.
The wound is the place where the light enters you.
Some days are not about becoming. They are about staying.
This story is still being written.
